id: 17_Laboratory Safety Mitigating Electrical Risks and Hazards in the Workplace Train
title: 实验室安全：减缓工作场所的电气风险
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/17_Laboratory Safety Mitigating Electrical Risks and Hazards in the Workplace Train.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/17_Laboratory Safety Mitigating Electrical Risks and Hazards in the Workplace Train/src.py

points.K10: 按电流选导线和保护器
points.K23: 插线板：匹配负载、临时使用

shots.scene: 欣欣站在电路板焊接台旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a circuit board soldering bench and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看懂电，管住电气危害。
overlay: 实验室安全：减缓工作场所的电气风险

shots.scene: 阿杰对着仪器机柜的旋钮犹豫，不知从何下手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hesitates in front of an instrument cabinet full of knobs, unsure where to start.
shots.narration: 阿杰要用一台新仪器，心里没底。

shots.scene: 老李走过来，在空白白板前拿起笔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over and picks up a marker in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 老李说：先把电的基础弄明白。

shots.scene: 老李在配电柜前，白板上四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a hard hat by an electrical cabinet, with four icons on the whiteboard: battery, arrow, resistor, bulb.
shots.narration: 任何用电的行业，电气安全都很关键。

shots.scene: 四个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: Four icons light up one by one: a battery with a plus sign, a flowing arrow along a wire, a zigzag resistor and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 先懂电压、电流、电阻和功率。

shots.scene: 水泵推动水流，旁边电池推动电荷沿导线流动
shots.prompt_en: A pump pushes water through a pipe, next to a battery pushing charge dots along a wire. No people.
shots.narration: 电压推动电荷在导线里流动，像压力。

shots.scene: 电压表指针升高，旁边出现闪电警示
shots.prompt_en: A voltage gauge needle rises and a lightning warning triangle and a broken instrument icon appear. No people.
shots.narration: 电压越高，越可能电击或损坏设备。

shots.scene: 穿防护服戴面罩的人在发光的机柜前操作
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a protective suit and face shield works at a glowing equipment cabinet.
shots.narration: 懂电压，才知道该用什么防护和措施。

shots.scene: 水管变窄水流变慢，导线上的电阻符号
shots.prompt_en: A narrowing pipe slows the water, next to a zigzag resistor symbol on a wire. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻是材料对电流的阻碍，像摩擦。

shots.scene: 电阻很大的导线段发红发热
shots.prompt_en: A wire section with a large resistor glowing red with heat waves. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻过高，会过热、效率低。

shots.scene: 电阻很小的导线里电流箭头畅通奔涌，蓝色电弧
shots.prompt_en: Current arrows rushing freely through a wire with almost no resistance, a blue arc flickering. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻过低，电流就畅通无阻。

shots.scene: 老李戴安全帽仰头在机柜下检查线路
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a hard hat looks up while checking wiring beneath a cabinet.
shots.narration: 两头都危险，设计选材要考虑电阻。

shots.scene: 高压输电塔，电压图标加电流图标合成闪电
shots.prompt_en: A high-voltage transmission tower, with a battery icon and an arrow icon combining into a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 功率是电能消耗的速率，由电压电流决定。

shots.scene: 墙上工业插座插着插头
shots.prompt_en: An industrial plug inserted into a wall socket. No people.
shots.narration: 它表示电气系统能做多少功。

shots.scene: 大功率设备上方热浪滚滚
shots.prompt_en: A large heater icon with strong heat waves and a rising thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 功率大，用能多、发热多，风险更高。

shots.scene: 两段导线间电火花，导线剖面里小点沿箭头流动
shots.prompt_en: A spark between two wire ends, and a cutaway wire with small dots flowing along an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 电流是电荷的流动，某时刻流过的电量。

shots.scene: 夕阳下的输电塔，细导线发红冒烟
shots.prompt_en: Power towers at sunset, and an icon of a thin wire glowing red and smoking. No people.
shots.narration: 电流过大会发热，引起灼伤或火灾。

shots.scene: 电流穿过手臂的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram with a lightning arrow passing through the arm. No people.
shots.narration: 电击也是电流直接造成的。

shots.scene: 低电压电池图标旁出现警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A low voltage battery icon with a big current arrow and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 电压低，电流够大照样危险。

shots.section_title: 按电流选导线和保护器
shots.scene: 戴黄手套剪电线；老李在配电箱前接线
shots.prompt_en: Hands in yellow gloves cut a wire; the facility engineer wires a distribution box.
shots.narration: 懂电流，才能选对导线、断路器、熔断器，
overlay: 按电流选导线和保护器

shots.section_title: 按电流选导线和保护器
shots.scene: 导线温度计保持在绿色区
shots.prompt_en: A wire icon with a thermometer staying in the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 防止过热。

shots.scene: 一条直线箭头和一条波浪箭头
shots.prompt_en: A straight arrow moving forward and a wavy line moving back and forth. No people.
shots.narration: 电流分交流和直流两类，

shots.scene: 老李戴安全帽，用手电照着机柜看平板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a hard hat shines a flashlight into a cabinet while reading a tablet.
shots.narration: 各有特性，影响设计、运行和维护。

shots.scene: 电池、遥控器、手电筒图标，直线箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a battery, a remote control and a flashlight, linked by a straight arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 直流方向恒定，遥控器手电筒的电池就是。

shots.scene: 电脑、手机、LED灯板图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a computer, a mobile phone and an LED light panel. No people.
shots.narration: 电脑、手机、LED灯等电子设备也用直流。

shots.scene: 小研在实验台上调节直流电源
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student adjusts a benchtop power supply with a blank display.
shots.narration: 实验室常用直流电源，提供稳定电压。

shots.scene: 插线板插着充电器，波浪线来回
shots.prompt_en: A power strip with a charger plugged in, a wavy line swinging up and down. No people.
shots.narration: 交流电周期性换向，电压正负往复。

shots.scene: 输电塔沿长距离连到城市
shots.prompt_en: Power towers carrying lines over a long distance to a city icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电网送交流电，远距离输送损耗小。

shots.scene: 小研打开冰箱，旁边工业风扇转动
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a refrigerator while a large industrial fan spins nearby.
shots.narration: 冰箱、风扇和工业设备多用交流电机。

shots.scene: 高压警示标志，旁边波浪线
shots.prompt_en: A high voltage warning sign next to a wavy alternating current line. No people.
shots.narration: 高压交流电非常危险。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现六个危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside six floating hazard icons in a grid.
shots.narration: 实验室人员面临六大类电气危害：

shots.scene: 割伤的手指图标
shots.prompt_en: A cut finger icon with a small bandage, beside a broken glass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有割伤等间接伤害。

shots.scene: 手按在仪器控制面板上，带电导线、裸露端子图标
shots.prompt_en: A hand pressing an instrument control panel, with icons of a live bare wire and exposed terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 碰到带电导线、故障设备、裸露部件，

shots.scene: 电击闪电落到手形图标上
shots.prompt_en: A lightning shock striking a hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 就会被电击。

shots.scene: 倒地的小人图标，墙上插座冒黑烟
shots.prompt_en: A collapsed person pictogram on the floor near a wall socket giving off black smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 触电死亡是更致命的电击，

shots.scene: 高压大电流图标旁，心电图变成直线
shots.prompt_en: A high voltage and high current icon beside a heartbeat line that goes flat. No people.
shots.narration: 高电压大电流会致重伤甚至死亡。

shots.scene: 手掌灼伤图标，两电极间跳出明亮电弧
shots.prompt_en: A burned palm icon, and a bright arc jumping across a gap between two terminals. No people.
shots.narration: 电弧灼伤，来自电弧的高温。

shots.scene: 电流跨越间隙、从故障设备放电
shots.prompt_en: Current jumping across a gap and discharging from a faulty instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 电流跨过间隙或从故障设备放电成弧。

shots.scene: 短路、设备故障、高压源三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a short circuit spark, a broken instrument and a high voltage sign. No people.
shots.narration: 多见于故障、短路或靠近高压作业。

shots.scene: 房屋起火图标，插座起火冒烟
shots.prompt_en: A house fire icon and a wall socket bursting into flame and smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 各类电气事故里，火灾最危险。

shots.scene: 导线过热、短路、火花点燃纸张
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an overheated glowing wire, a short circuit spark, and a spark igniting paper. No people.
shots.narration: 过热、短路或火花点燃易燃物。

shots.scene: 手指靠近金属把手冒出小火花
shots.prompt_en: A small static spark jumps from a fingertip to a metal handle. No people.
shots.narration: 静电，是物体表面积聚的电荷。

shots.scene: 锥形瓶冒白雾，实验台上器皿起火
shots.prompt_en: A flask giving off white vapor, and a dish on a bench catching fire after a spark. No people.
shots.narration: 放电能点燃易燃蒸气、气体或粉尘，

shots.scene: 爆炸图标
shots.prompt_en: An explosion burst icon over a vapor cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 引起火灾或爆炸。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手按仪器键盘，电路板芯片出现裂纹
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand presses an instrument keypad, and a chip icon shows a lightning crack. No people.
shots.narration: 静电还会损坏敏感电子元件。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，身旁有盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up beside a shield icon.
shots.narration: 听着吓人，但都有办法避免。

shots.scene: 配电柜起火、电缆破皮露铜线、墙内乱线
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a burning electrical cabinet, a cable with torn insulation exposing copper, and tangled wiring in a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，线路和接头故障。

shots.scene: 放大镜扫过电线，找出磨损、裸露、松动
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass scans a cable and finds a frayed spot, an exposed conductor and a loose connection. No people.
shots.narration: 查电线磨损、导体裸露、接头松动。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手整理接线板，换上新电线
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands tidy a terminal block and fit a new cable in place of a worn one.
shots.narration: 损坏老化的电线，立即更换。

shots.section_title: 插线板：匹配负载、临时使用
shots.scene: 插满插头的插线板，烧焦的插孔
shots.prompt_en: A power strip crammed with plugs, and a scorched socket hole. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，电路过载、插线板用错。
overlay: 插线板：匹配负载、临时使用

shots.section_title: 插线板：匹配负载、临时使用
shots.scene: 插线板空白额定值标签与设备负载天平
shots.prompt_en: A power strip with a blank rating label balanced against an instrument load icon on a scale. No people.
shots.narration: 额定值要和负载匹配，插线板无损伤。

shots.section_title: 插线板：匹配负载、临时使用
shots.scene: 插线板旁时钟图标，地上电缆盘
shots.prompt_en: A power strip with a small clock icon, and a cable reel on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板只作临时用。

shots.scene: 小研在电脑和仪器前工作，身后电缆外皮完好、套在保护管里
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a computer and instruments; behind her, cables with intact insulation run inside protective conduit.
shots.narration: 第三，绝缘不良：电线电缆都要绝缘好，

shots.scene: 保护套管包住电缆的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a cable running inside a protective sleeve. No people.
shots.narration: 并且加以保护。

shots.scene: 三孔插头特写，接地符号
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a three-pin plug with a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第四，带三孔插头的设备，

shots.scene: 手把三孔插头插进墙上插座，接地线连到地
shots.prompt_en: A hand plugs the three-pin plug into a wall socket, with a ground wire line leading to earth. No people.
shots.narration: 都要可靠接到合格的接地线上。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现电压、电流、电阻、功率图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a battery, an arrow, a resistor and a bulb.
shots.narration: 电压、电流、电阻、功率，先弄懂。

shots.scene: 电击、灼伤、火灾、静电图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a lightning shock, a burn mark, a flame and a static spark. No people.
shots.narration: 六类危害，电击、灼伤、火灾、静电。

shots.scene: 完好电线、合适插线板、接地插座打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: an intact cable, a matched power strip and a grounded socket. No people.
shots.narration: 查线路、管插线板、护绝缘、接好地。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验台旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 安全用电，从懂电开始，下次见！
